description: This file defines an interface for listening to configuration reload events related to the service engine in the Apache OFBiz framework. It contains a method that is invoked when the service configuration changes.

classes.name: ServiceConfigListener
classes.description: Interface for objects that need to process notifications when the service engine configuration file (serviceengine.xml) is reloaded.

methods.name: onServiceConfigChange
methods.description: Method called to process updates to the service engine configuration, accepting a ServiceConfig instance representing the new configuration.
